description: Times INT32 multiply-add work at the recorded grid geometry. The declared sweep uses one block. Emits raw GPU time and workload descriptors; qualified integer-operation throughput is derived downstream and is not a measured whole-device peak.

scaling_param.name: mads_per_thread
scaling_param.description: Number of integer MAD operations per thread per kernel invocation; controls total compute work

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of thread blocks in the grid; the declared sweep uses one block. Multiplying a single-block rate by SM/CU count is an extrapolation model, not a measured device-wide rate.

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: When true, run the untimed vector-add warmer before each timed operation to raise clocks and disturb cache state; qualify the resulting state on the target. False disables the warmer without promising a particular cache state.
